title: Hardware engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Hardware engineer em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Hardware Electronics Engineer Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience) Type Full-Time, On-Site Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus About Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular Io T modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R& D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R& D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — Our history & global footprint — LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial Io T, connected payments, and more. Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R& D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market. \"Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay.\" What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I2 C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5 G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R& D — work side-by-side with our R& D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: | Browse open roles: Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

title: Technical project manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Technical project manager em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Company Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, Git Hub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms. Required Skills ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows. What Success Looks Like Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

Day-to-day experience with Git and Agile workflows. Strong problem-solving skills and customer-friendly communication. Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For AI / machine learning experience for image analysis. Familiarity with Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X / Chi-CDK). Prior FAE or customer-engineering experience in the LATAM region. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R& D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — quectel. Com Our history & global footprint — quectel. Com/company/history LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial Io T, connected payments, and more. Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R& D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market. "Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay." What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I2 C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5 G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R& D — work side-by-side with our R& D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: sasha.saini@ | Browse open roles: quectel. Com/recruitment Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

title: Senior java developer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior java developer em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

A VMetrix é uma plataforma Saa S que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho. Propósito do Cargo Como Senior Java Developer, você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento Backend Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração. Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe. Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção. Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput. Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas. Design e Arquitetura Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios. Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos. Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos. Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas. Banco de Dados e Integrações Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados. Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados. Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais. Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas. Infraestrutura e Deploy Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações Web Logic. Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (Git Lab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment. Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos. Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe. Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA. Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas. Colaboração e Crescimento Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade. Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento. Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos. Requisitos Obrigatórios: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java. Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes). Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design Go F (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema. Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento. Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras. Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte. Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual. Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD. Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/Open API para desenvolvimento de APIs. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta. Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR. Requisitos Desejáveis: Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning. Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS. Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing. Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs. Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações Web Logic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares. Experiência trabalhando em plataformas Saa S ou sistemas multi-tenant. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes. O Que Valorizamos: Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana. Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo. Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness. Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe. Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real. Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício. Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo Linked In. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos "fazer mais barulho", mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

Transformar roteiros e conceitos técnicos em animações claras, bonitas e fáceis de entender. Animar ícones, gráficos, interfaces, fluxos de pagamento, dashboards, transações e elementos visuais da marca. Apoiar a produção de vídeos para campanhas de mídia paga, eventos, lançamentos e ações comerciais. Criar variações de peças animadas para testes de performance e diferentes formatos de distribuição. Editar vídeos curtos com ritmo, cortes, legendas, trilhas, transições e acabamento profissional. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com Design e Conteúdo para garantir coesão visual e narrativa da marca. Ajudar a evoluir a linguagem visual da Pay Conductor em movimento, respeitando identidade, paleta, tipografia e estilo da marca. Trazer referências visuais, tendências de motion, formatos de redes sociais e ideias para elevar a qualidade criativa dos conteúdos. VOCÊ AGREGARÁ SE POSSUIR: Portfólio com projetos de motion design, edição de vídeo, animação ou peças em movimento. Domínio de ferramentas como After Effects, Premiere, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Cap Cut ou similares. Boa noção de composição visual, ritmo, hierarquia, transição, storytelling e acabamento. Sensibilidade estética para criar peças modernas, limpas e com aparência premium. Capacidade de transformar temas técnicos em narrativas visuais simples e interessantes. Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas em uma rotina dinâmica de marketing. Repertório ativo de referências visuais, redes sociais, design, tecnologia e cultura digital. Vontade de aprender sobre fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce e inteligência artificial. VOCÊ SE DESTACARÁ SE TIVER: Experiência prévia com marcas B2 B, Saa S, fintech, tecnologia, meios de pagamento ou e-commerce. Experiência com animação de UI, dashboards, fluxos de produto e interfaces digitais. Conhecimento em Lottie, Rive, Cinema 4 D, Blender ou outras ferramentas de animação/3 D. Experiência criando vídeos para campanhas de performance, anúncios e testes de criativos. Noções de design gráfico, direção de arte e criação de conceitos visuais. Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação, edição, storyboard ou geração de assets. Repertório de marcas com identidade visual forte, linguagem tecnológica e comunicação diferenciada. Que saiba equilibrar estética com comunicação. Que entenda quando uma peça precisa ser mais institucional, mais comercial, mais educativa ou mais social-first. Na Pay Conductor, você terá espaço para propor, testar e evoluir a linguagem visual de uma marca que está entrando em uma categoria nova e estratégica para o mercado brasileiro. title: Senior python engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior python engineer em rio branco. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Company: Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Tik Tok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, Big Query, Snowflake, and LLMs like Chat GPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more. We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API's and scalability. Technology: We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.) Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact Fluency in English is mandatory How we work: We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews. title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
Confira a vaga para Assessor de investimentos em boa vista. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição da geral: Estamos em busca de um(a) Profissional Financeiro com certificação CPA-10 ou CPA-20 para atuar no suporte e atendimento a clientes, análise de perfil de investidor, e distribuição de produtos financeiros. O(a) profissional ideal tem perfil analítico, boa comunicação e experiência no setor bancário ou de investimentos. Responsabilidades: Prestar atendimento e suporte técnico/consultivo a clientes pessoa física e jurídica; Realizar análises de perfil de investidor (suitability) e apoiar na recomendação de produtos financeiros; Comercializar produtos como CDB, LCI/LCA, fundos de investimento, previdência, entre outros; Apoiar a área comercial no processo de prospecção e fidelização de clientes; Atualizar cadastros, monitorar prazos e garantir conformidade com as normas da ANBIMA e do BACEN; Acompanhar indicadores e relatórios de desempenho da carteira de investimentos. Requisitos: Certificação CPA-10 ou CPA-20 (obrigatória); Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras, cooperativas de crédito ou corretoras; Conhecimento em produtos bancários e investimentos; Facilidade com sistemas bancários, Excel e plataformas de investimento; Boa comunicação, proatividade e foco em resultados. Diferenciais: Certificações adicionais (CEA, CFP, ANCORD); Vivência com atendimento consultivo em agências bancárias ou mesas de investimentos; Domínio de ferramentas como Smarkia, BLK, ou plataformas de investimentos digitais. Benefícios: Salário compatível com o mercado Participação nos lucros (PLR) Vale-refeição e alimentação Plano de saúde e odontológico Previdência privada Programa de desenvolvimento e capacitação contínua

title: Professor de espanhol
description:
Empresa está contratando Professor de espanhol em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Cloud windows infrastructure engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Cloud windows infrastructure engineer em rio branco. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer Job Purpose As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, Power Shell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem. AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb. The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms. This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function. Role Responsibilities Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation. Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services. Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA. Author and maintain Power Shell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate. Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, Cloud Watch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service. Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning. Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, Cloud Watch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards. Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards. Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation. Essential Skills & Experience Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary) 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above. Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery. Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSo P, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering. IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning. DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience. Advanced Power Shell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity. Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments. Windows performance troubleshooting: Perf Mon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics. Identity & Authentication Hybrid identity: AD on-prem cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS. SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting. Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments. AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence) Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, Cloud Watch. AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store. AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector. Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow. Service Operations & Remote Working Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management. Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA. Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken. Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup. Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague. Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer: Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office. Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role. Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage. Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage. On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

title: Senior full-stack engineer (.net / ai)
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior full-stack engineer (.net / ai) em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Andela At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 10 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America. As one of the world's largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & Dev Ops, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company's exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry's only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster. Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI. Join us and change the world. Role Overview We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (. NET / AI) to help build and scale the next generation of applications for one of our growing enterprise clients. This is a senior-level engineering role with a strong backend focus, combining modern full-stack development with AI-powered application development. You will be responsible for architecting and building scalable systems, establishing development standards, integrating Generative AI solutions into production environments, and driving technical decisions across multiple initiatives. The role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, enjoys building systems from scratch, and can operate as a highly autonomous technical leader while collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders. Exceptional Leadership As an Andelan, you'll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you — if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you. Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea. One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone. Great listener, hungry for feedback: You're always seeking to improve — our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen. Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you. Player-coach: You fly high and low. You understand the strategy while staying close to the details that matter. You roll up your sleeves, stay hands-on, and empower others without micromanaging. Business problem solver: You're not just a functional expert; you approach your work through the lens of solving business problems. Key Responsibilities Backend Architecture & Development Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems using. NET and C#. Architect robust APIs, services, and application infrastructure that support current and future products. Establish engineering standards, best practices, and maintainable system architectures. Drive technical decisions that improve scalability, reliability, security, and performance. Full-Stack Development Collaborate with frontend teams working in React to deliver end-to-end application functionality. Contribute across the full stack when needed while maintaining a strong backend focus. Ensure seamless integration between frontend experiences and backend services. Support application modernization and continuous improvement initiatives. AI & Generative AI Integration Design and implement Generative AI solutions within production applications. Evaluate and integrate LLM-powered capabilities that improve business processes and operational efficiency. Build AI-enabled workflows, automation systems, and intelligent application features. Stay current with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to create business value. Technical Leadership & Solution Design Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across projects. Make informed technology decisions in environments with evolving requirements and limited structure. Lead solution design discussions and identify the best approaches for implementation. Drive engineering excellence through mentorship, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Collaboration & Delivery Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Partner with leadership to align technical strategy with business goals. Participate in planning, estimation, prioritization, and delivery activities. Ensure solutions are delivered with high quality and maintainability. Qualifications & Competencies Experience 8+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend development. Extensive hands-on experience with. NET and C#. Strong full-stack development experience with modern web application architectures. Experience building and deploying production-grade applications. Experience working in startup, scale-up, or high-growth environments. AI & Modern Engineering Proven experience integrating Generative AI solutions into production applications. Hands-on experience working with LLMs, AI-powered workflows, or intelligent automation systems. Understanding of AI orchestration patterns, agentic workflows, or AI application architecture. Experience evaluating and implementing emerging AI technologies. Technical Expertise Strong knowledge of software architecture, system design, APIs, and distributed systems. Experience designing scalable and maintainable backend services. Deep understanding of modern development practices, testing strategies, and deployment workflows. Strong problem-solving and debugging capabilities. Leadership & Communication Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills. Ability to operate independently and make high-impact technical decisions. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and changing priorities. Strong ownership mentality and accountability for outcomes. Nice to Have Experience with Claude and AI orchestration frameworks. Experience with AI agents, RAG architectures, or advanced LLM implementation patterns. Experience building products or platforms from scratch. Experience leading technical teams or serving as a technical lead. Experience working in highly autonomous engineering environments. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who is more than a software developer. The ideal candidate is a senior engineer who can own technical outcomes, architect scalable solutions, integrate AI into real-world products, and operate with minimal oversight. You should be comfortable making architectural decisions, solving complex backend challenges, collaborating across functions, and leveraging AI technologies to create business impact. This role is best suited for someone who is highly autonomous, technically strong, product-minded, and excited about building the future of AI-enabled software systems. Role Details Location: Remote (LATAM / Americas) Time Zone: Must maintain a minimum of 6 hours overlap with US working hours Contract Type: Contracting Duration: 12 Months Expected Start Date: 22 June 2026 Assessment Path:. NET Required Technologies:. NET, C#, React, Type Script, Generative AI Apply Now Apply now to join Andela's global talent network and support the development of next-generation AI-powered applications for a fast-growing technology-driven organization. This is an excellent opportunity for a Senior Software Engineer, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Backend Engineer who enjoys modern architecture, AI-powered development, technical leadership, and building scalable systems from the ground up.

We are looking for a FULL-TIME Customer Success Manager to be the main point of contact between our customers and our technical team. Our Company is Deep Fork Automation, and you will join a team of 10 (most of whom are international remote workers). We work in Automation, SCADA and Remote Monitoring. You will be paid in US Dollars. On top of monthly salary, we include National holidays off, Paid Time Off, and other benefits. Additionally, we have annual performance reviews with raises and bonuses. Your schedule will follow US business hours so you can support our customers and coordinate with the team. We hope this works out and can become a very long term employment opportunity. If this is you, please apply!

description:

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\" Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS:* Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos. *PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES* Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia. title: Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese )
description:
Empresa está contratando Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese ) em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Company Description: Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, Million Logics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results. Role Overview: As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness. Offer Details: Duration of Contract: 12 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) Key Qualifications: Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Additional Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 12 months

The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team. Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: These may include but are not limited to: Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned. Required Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action Travel: You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

title: English teacher
description:
Empresa está contratando English teacher em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Business development representative (remote)
description:
Confira a vaga para Business development representative (remote) em palmas. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Oi! Na Bizneo somos uma das maiores plataformas de HR Tech da Europa e LATAM, com mais de 30 módulos de software para gestão de pessoas :) Estamos buscando reforços para o time comercial no Brasil: alguém que curta o jogo da prospecção, entenda rápido um produto complexo e saiba ter uma conversa de verdade com um gestor de RH — não só seguir um script. O que você vai fazer aqui? Prospectar e abordar empresas do mercado brasileiro por telefone, e-mail e Linked In, gerando oportunidades qualificadas para o time de vendas. Este é um papel de SDR/BDR puro: seu foco é abrir portas, não fechar contratos. Entender o cenário de cada prospect: como gerenciam seus processos de RH hoje, quais são suas dores reais e onde a Bizneo pode fazer diferença. Qualificar oportunidades com critério, não com volume. Nos interessa mais uma reunião boa do que dez reuniões fracas. Manter o CRM atualizado e organizado. Dados limpos não são burocracia, são o que faz a máquina comercial funcionar. Colaborar com o time de vendas e marketing para refinar mensagens, cadências e estratégias de abordagem com base no que você vê no campo. O que buscamos? Experiência prévia em prospecção, pré-vendas (SDR, BDR, Inside Sales) ou vendas internas em empresas de tecnologia ou Saa S. Pode ser pouca, mas tem que ser real. Você é curioso/a sobre o produto que vende. Não quer só agendar reuniões — quer entender o que está vendendo e por que resolve o problema do cliente. Comunicação clara e natural, tanto por escrito quanto por telefone. Sabe adaptar o tom ao interlocutor sem soar robótico. Organização e disciplina no dia a dia: gerenciar pipeline, seguir cadências e cumprir follow-ups sem que ninguém precise cobrar. Gosta de trabalhar com metas e se motiva com resultados, mas entende que consistência importa mais que picos. Pontos extra se... Já vendeu ou prospectou software de RH, gestão de pessoas ou Saa S B2 B para o mercado mid-market. Tem familiaridade com ferramentas como Hub Spot, Salesforce ou plataformas de sales engagement (Apollo, Outreach, etc.). Fala espanhol. O que oferecemos? Teletrabalho 100% — para sempre, de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Jornada flexível de segunda a sexta. Treinamento contínuo no produto e em técnicas de venda consultiva. Possibilidades reais de crescimento: vários dos nossos AEs de hoje começaram como SDRs.

title: Senior treasury analyst
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior treasury analyst em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company's credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements. The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities 1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus) • Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries. • Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure. • Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements. • Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines. • Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements. • Monitor guarantee utilization levels and facility limits, ensuring sufficient availability to support ongoing business operations and new contracts. • Maintain a guarantee tracking system/database to monitor expiration dates, renewals, and contractual obligations. • Work closely with legal, procurement, and commercial teams to review contract clauses related to financial guarantees, performance bonds, advance payment bonds, and retention guarantees. • Ensure timely release or reduction of guarantees when contractual obligations are fulfilled. • Support risk assessments related to guarantees, including country risk, counterparty risk, and insurer/bank exposure. • Assist in building and maintaining strategic relationships with financial institutions and insurers across the LATAM region. Cash Management & Treasury Operations • Monitor daily cash balances across LATAM bank accounts, ensuring adequate liquidity and compliance with corporate treasury policies. • Support regional liquidity planning and cash positioning, including funding requirements between accounts. • Execute manual payments through banking platforms, including payments related to taxes, payroll, and judicial obligations. • Maintain accurate cash forecasting and treasury reporting in the IT2 Treasury Management System. • Support the execution and documentation of foreign exchange (FX) transactions required for LATAM operations. • Monitor FX exposure and support compliance with internal treasury policies and local regulatory requirements. • Assist in maintaining bank account documentation, including the management and reporting of authorized bank account signatories. • Ensure proper documentation and reconciliation of treasury transactions, addressing any discrepancies or queries. • Support internal and external audits related to treasury activities. Stakeholder Management • Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Commercial teams to ensure proper structuring of guarantees and financial obligations within contracts. • Support on maintain effective relationships with banks, insurers, and brokers to support regional treasury operations. • Act as a key contact for guarantee-related matters within the organization. Requirements Education • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. Professional Experience • Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury environment, with exposure to bank guarantees, surety bonds, or insurance guarantees. • Experience working with LATAM treasury operations is highly desirable. Technical Knowledge • Solid knowledge of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds. • Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) operations and compliance requirements. • Experience using Treasury Management Systems (preferably IT2). • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Skills & Competencies • Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills. • Ability to review contractual financial terms and assess risk exposure. • Strong negotiation skills when dealing with banks, insurers, and brokers. • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. • Ability to work under time-sensitive conditions and manage multiple priorities. • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Languages • Advanced English (required). • Intermediate Spanish (desirable). Candidatos da cidade de São Paulo - SP, residir 24 KM do escritório da Unisys localizado na (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá ir presencial 3 vezes na semana presencial.
